title: EPFO Retains PF Interest Rate at 8.25% for FY26 (3rd Consecutive Year)
summary: EPFO Central Board of Trustees decides to maintain EPF interest rate at 8.25% for 7.8 crore members for FY2025-26.

blocks.content: EPFO's 239th CBT meeting decided to **retain the EPF interest rate at 8.25% for FY26** for ~7.8 crore contributing members (3rd consecutive year unchanged).

items: **Deficit Cushion**: FY26 expected deficit of ₹944.06 Cr offset via ₹5,480.34 Cr surplus from previous year.
**EPFO Leadership**: CEO Ramesh Krishnamurthi (Est. 1952, HQ: New Delhi).
